entries.text: This year, at midnight on the seventh night of the fog season, the fog will withdraw for one whole night and the north road can be walked; the whole town is stuck here waiting for it. The game opens on the fifth night.
Blades in town must be peace-bonded: anyone who draws steel in town without a duelling licence from the Town Office is marched off by the watch and spends a night in the Town Office cells.
There is a curfew on fog-season nights, and the watch questions anyone out walking the streets after dark; thieving is easier at night, and getting caught is more trouble.
